notes: Body roster and deployment state. Source of truth for deployments: oscen/deploy/overlays.env OSCEN_ALL_BRAINS (four brains: the 1M, audio, humanoid-stand, humanoid-locomotion). All bodies are simulated (MuJoCo, or the VocalTractLab vocal tract for speech). Keep in sync when brains are added or retired.

bodies.name: pendulum
bodies.label: Inverted Pendulum
bodies.description: 1-DOF inverted pendulum. Simplest motor control task. Teaches active angle control via STDP and eligibility traces.

bodies.name: arm_2dof
bodies.label: 2-DOF Planar Arm
bodies.description: 2-DOF fixed-base arm for reach-to-target coordination on the manipulation channel. No brain is training on it today (the manipulation bed was retired 2026-09-28).

bodies.name: speech_only
bodies.label: Speech-Only Brain
bodies.description: No physics body. A simulated vocal tract (22 articulators) driven by a dedicated motor sub-range. Used by the 100K audio specialist for the speech curriculum (babbling, then vowels, then first words).

bodies.name: humanoid_29dof
bodies.label: 29-DOF Humanoid (simulated)
bodies.description: Simulated humanoid with 29 actuated joints across locomotion (15), manipulation (12), and head (2) channels. The 1M brain and two humanoid specialists train on it. Standing and walking are still being learned.
